intro.summary: West-end community of single-detached homes between Bow Trail and the Bow River, next to Edworthy Park.
intro.body: Wildwood lies between Bow Trail SW and the Bow River, with Edworthy Park and the river pathways along its northern edge. Almost every home is single-detached, many of them 1950s bungalows on wide lots. Redevelopment here is mostly new single-detached homes replacing older ones.
